name: medallion
note: 14 Medallion (provisional name; brief 2026-11-12: the form of references/packaging/14_medallion.png, charcoal colour from references/packaging/14_medallion_charcoal.png). Square ring box, 90 x 90 mm, 66 mm tall. Base (0 to base_top) and lid (base_top + reveal to height) are separate shells; a lighter charcoal suede collar inside the base rises collar_rise above the lid's lower edge, so it shows as a recessed band in the reveal all round. The lid is hinged at its outer back edge at the lid's lower edge and opens to open_deg. At the front centre the base wall has a U notch; a tab on the lid's front wall drops into it with clearance, and a domed rounded-square champagne-gold medallion on the tab straddles the reveal. Inside: lined tray, ring pad with one slit, Perhaps in gold serif on the lid lining.

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB (charcoal twill colour swatch, lighter charcoal suede, champagne gold); renders swap in config/presets/box_medallion_look.json.
